objectives: Recognizing some of the English alphabet letters.
lessons.body:
Domain: Oral – Written
Objective: Recognizing some of the English alphabet letters.


Materials: Word cards (The Alphabet).

▪ Presentation: / Practice (5m / 8-10m / 25-30m): Warming up:
   Listen and perform game (or mime it). Point , read , cross, tick .. (previous lesson).
   T. presents some letters using word cards (the number of the letters depends on pupils performance (deal with 10 letters if you see that it is too much for them deal with few letters only or vice versa).
   T. makes Pp repeat each time he/she presents a letter (chorally then individually).
   Task1:
   T. shows a letter, Pp say it.
   Task2:
   T. distributes the letters to PP, says a letter and makes the pupil who has the corresponding card go to the board and show it (PP repeat).
   Task 3:
   T. sticks the cards on the board, says a letter and makes a learner go up to the board and point at it (PP dealt with the verb point in lesson 1).
   (You can deal with only two tasks. It is due to time management).
   The same as task 3, but here, a pp says a letter, another one points at it (Game like).
   (Deal with the other letters and tasks ( 06 / 07 )in the same way. This will help PP to learn the alphabet in a motivating way.
   You can deal with the game (Find your partner) later. Distribute some cards (small and capital letters), ask a pp who has the small letter to go up to the board, then the other one who has the same letter (capital) joins him/her (other pp repeat).
   (You can print the letters, or just write them on small sheets (script not cursive).
   then you deal with the alphabet song if you want.
   Link: https://youtu.be/75p-N9YKqNo
   Remember it: What we learn with pleasure, we never forget.
   [T.SS / T.SS / S.SS / T.S / T.S / S.SS / T.S / S.SS]

lessons.topic: Oral — Greet people and recognize/say the names of the Sidou family members
lessons.materials: Textbook (p. 8), flashcards of the Sidou family, board.
objectives: By the end of the lesson, my learners will be able to greet people and recognize/say the names of the Sidou family members.
Target structures: Hello. / Hi.
Lexis: Mr Sidou, Mrs Sidou, Yassine, Meriem, Lilia.
lessons.body:
Domain: Oral
Objective: By the end of the lesson, my learners will be able to greet people and recognize/say the names of the Sidou family members.
Target structures: Hello. / Hi.
Lexis: Mr Sidou, Mrs Sidou, Yassine, Meriem, Lilia.
Materials: Textbook (p. 8), flashcards of the Sidou family, board.

▪ Warming up (2-5m): The teacher greets learners and welcomes them. 1, 2, 3. Learn English with me!
   Quick review of the classroom commands (listen – look – point – repeat) using flashcards.
   [T.SS / S.SS]
▪ Presentation (8-10m): T. shows the picture on page 8 (or flashcards) and says: “Hello, I’m Mr Sidou…”, pointing at each character.
   Activity 1 (Listen and show): T. says a name, PP point at the right character in their books.
   Activity 2 (Listen and repeat): T. says each name, PP repeat (chorally then individually).
   [T.SS / SS.T]
▪ Practice (15-20m): Task 1:
   T. points at a character, PP say the name (chorally / individually).
   Task 2:
   T. sticks the flashcards on the board, says a name; a pupil goes up and points at the right card.
   Task 3:
   A pupil says a name; another one points at it (game-like).
   [T.S / S.S / S.SS]
▪ Use/produce (8-10m): PP wave and say “Hello” to the characters, then to their classmates (role-play: one pupil = one Sidou family member).
   Tip: the aim is recognition and oral repetition only; no writing in this session.
   [S.S / T.S]

lessons.body:
Domain: Oral – Written
Objective: By the end of the lesson, my learners will be able to greet and say goodbye (Hello / Good bye) and recognize the written words.
Target structures: Hello. / Good bye.
Lexis: hello, good bye.
Materials: Textbook (p. 9), flashcards (Hello / Good bye), colour pencils, copybook.

▪ Warming up (2-5m): The teacher greets learners and welcomes them. 1, 2, 3. Learn English with me!
   Review the names of the Sidou family (flashcards).
   [T.SS / S.SS]
▪ Presentation (8-10m): T. presents the two expressions with gestures (waving): “Hello!” / “Good bye!”. PP repeat chorally then individually.
   Activity 3 (Listen, look and do the same with your friend): T. models the dialogue with a pupil, then PP do the same in pairs.
   [T.SS / T.S / S.S]
▪ Practice (15-20m): Task 1:
   T. shows a flashcard (Hello / Good bye), PP say the right word.
   Task 2:
   T. writes both words on the board; PP read them aloud.
   Activity 4 (Read and colour ‘Hello’ and ‘Good bye’ in your copybook):
   PP read the words in each column and colour only the correctly spelled ones (Hello and Good bye). Deal with an example on the board first.
   [T.S / SS.T / S]
▪ Use/produce (8-10m): Pairs of PP greet each other and say goodbye in front of the class (“Hello, …!” / “Good bye!”).
   [S.S]

lessons.topic: Oral — Recognize and say the family members (father, mother, grandfather, grandmother, brother, sister, me)
objectives: By the end of the lesson, my learners will be able to recognize and say the family members (father, mother, grandfather, grandmother, brother, sister, me).
Lexis: father (dad), mother (mum), grandfather (grandpa), grandmother (grandma), brother, sister, me.
lessons.body:
Domain: Oral
Objective: By the end of the lesson, my learners will be able to recognize and say the family members (father, mother, grandfather, grandmother, brother, sister, me).

Lexis: father (dad), mother (mum), grandfather (grandpa), grandmother (grandma), brother, sister, me.
Materials: Textbook (p. 10), family flashcards, audio (ABC song).

▪ Warming up (2-5m): The teacher greets learners and welcomes them. 1, 2, 3. Learn English with me!
   Greetings game: “Hello / Good bye” with a partner.
   [T.SS / S.SS]
▪ Presentation (8-10m): T. presents the family members using flashcards (show – point – listen – look – read).
   T. asks PP to repeat each word (choral then individual repetition), including the short forms: dad, mum, grandpa, grandma.
   [T.SS / SS.T]
▪ Practice (15-20m): Task 1:
   T. shows a flashcard, PP say the word.
   Task 2:
   T. distributes the flashcards; T. says a word and the pupil who has the card goes up and shows it.
   Activity 5 (Listen, look and match in your copybook – example: 4 = D):
   PP listen and match numbers 1–7 with letters A–G.
   Suggested key (check with the picture): 1 = C, 2 = E, 3 = G, 4 = D, 5 = B, 6 = A, 7 = F.
   Activities 6 and 7:
   PP sound the letters of the alphabet and sing the ABC song.
   [T.S / S.SS / T.SS / SS]
▪ Use/produce (8-10m): PP show a family photo (or a drawing) and say the words they know: “This is my … (mum / dad).”
   You can postpone “This is my…” to the pictionary session if it is too difficult.
   [S.S]

lessons.body:
Domain: Oral – Written
Objective: By the end of the lesson, my learners will be able to complete the family words with the missing letter and say their names.
Target structures: Hello, I’m … . What’s your name?
Lexis: grandmother, grandfather, mother, father, sister, brother.
Materials: Textbook (p. 11), flashcards, word cards, copybook.

▪ Warming up (2-5m): The teacher greets learners and welcomes them. 1, 2, 3. Learn English with me!
   Review the family members using flashcards (flash and say).
   [T.SS / S.SS]
▪ Presentation (8-10m): Activity 8 (Look, read and complete the words):
   T. shows the first example on the board: “..?.. randmother” → g. PP choose the right letter box and circle it in their copybook.
   [T.SS / S]
▪ Practice (15-20m): PP complete the words A–F and circle the right box in their copybook.
   Key: A: g (2) – B: g (3) – C: m (2) – D: f (3) – E: s (2) – F: b (3).
   T. checks orally: PP read the complete word (grandmother, grandfather, mother, father, sister, brother) and spell it.
   [S / SS.T]
▪ Use/produce (8-10m): Activity 9 (Listen and say your name):
   T. introduces herself: “Hello, I’m … What’s your name?” PP answer: “Hello, I’m …”. Then Robotkid and Fennec in the picture. Each pupil introduces himself/herself.
   [T.S / S.S]

Objective: By the end of the lesson, my learners will be able to ask and answer about names and say/show the numbers from 0 to 10.
Target structures: What’s your name? – I’m … .

▪ Warming up (2-5m): The teacher greets learners and welcomes them. 1, 2, 3. Learn English with me!

   Task 1:

lessons.body:
Domain: Oral
Objective: By the end of the lesson, my learners will be able to listen to a short story and identify the scenes using numbers.
Target structures: Hello. / What’s your name? / Numbers 1–4.
Lexis: revision: greetings, names, numbers.
Materials: Textbook (p. 13), audio of the story, picture cards (scenes 1–4).

▪ Warming up (2-5m): The teacher greets learners and welcomes them. 1, 2, 3. Learn English with me!
   Review numbers 0–10 (flash cards).
   [T.SS / S.SS]
▪ Presentation (8-10m): Activity 12 (Listen to the story):
   T. asks PP to look at the four pictures and guess who the characters are and where they are (park). Then PP listen to the story twice.
   [T.SS / SS]

Domain: Oral
Objective: By the end of the lesson, my learners will be able to ask and answer about age.
Target structures: How old are you? – I’m 7. / How old is she (he)? – She’s (He’s) 8.
Lexis: numbers 3–10; he, she.
Materials: Textbook (p. 14), flashcards (numbers and characters), board.

▪ Warming up (2-5m): The teacher greets learners and welcomes them. 1, 2, 3. Learn English with me!

   [T.SS / S.SS]

   [T.SS / SS.T]
▪ Practice (15-20m): Activity 14 (continued):
   T. says a sentence (e.g. “He’s ten”); PP tick the right box in their copybook.
   Activity 15 (Ask and answer):
   T. models: “How old are you?” – “I’m 7.” and “How old is she?” – “She’s 8.” PP practise in pairs, then in front of the class.
   [T.S / S.S / S.SS]
▪ Use/produce (8-10m): Activity 16 (Listen to the story again – activity 12, page 13 – and act out ‘scene 4’):

lessons.body:
Domain: Oral – Written
Objective: By the end of the lesson, my learners will be able to understand and say simple sentences to introduce themselves and a friend (name, age, home town, language).
Target structures: I’m ten. I live in Algiers. I speak Arabic. / He’s eight. He lives in London. He speaks English.
Lexis: live, speak, Arabic, English, French; names: Bakir, Tin Hinan, Meriem, Lotfi.
Materials: Textbook (p. 15), audio, flashcards (languages), map or flags.

▪ Warming up (2-5m): The teacher greets learners and welcomes them. 1, 2, 3. Learn English with me!
   Review: “How old are you?” – “I’m …” in pairs.
   [T.SS / S.SS]
▪ Presentation (8-10m): Activity 17 (Listen and match in your copybook):
   T. presents the four names (Bakir, Tin Hinan, Meriem, Lotfi); PP listen and match each picture (1–4) with a name (A–D). Example: 2 = C.
   Check the answers against the audio script.
   [T.SS / S]
▪ Practice (15-20m): Activity 18 (Listen, read and do the same with your friend):
   T. reads Robotten’s speech: “Hello, I’m Robotten. I’m ten. I live in Algiers. I speak Arabic, English and French.” PP repeat sentence by sentence.
   Same procedure with Peter (“He’s eight. He lives in London. He speaks English.”).
   Draw PP’s attention to the difference: I live / he lives; I speak / he speaks (oral awareness only).
   [T.SS / SS.T / T.S]
▪ Use/produce (8-10m): In pairs, PP introduce themselves and then their partner: “I’m … I’m … I live in … I speak …”.
   [S.S]

lessons.segmentTitle: Sequence 1: Me, my family and my friends
lessons.topic: Oral – Written — Recognize and pronounce the vowel sound /ɪ/
objectives: By the end of the lesson, my learners will be able to recognize and pronounce the vowel sound /ɪ/.
Target structures: Six sisters.
Lexis: six, sister(s), tick, ship, fish (words with /ɪ/).
lessons.body:
Domain: Oral – Written
Objective: By the end of the lesson, my learners will be able to recognize and pronounce the vowel sound /ɪ/.
Target structures: Six sisters.
Lexis: six, sister(s), tick, ship, fish (words with /ɪ/).
Materials: Textbook (p. 16), phonics flashcards, audio.

▪ Warming up (2-5m): The teacher greets learners and welcomes them. 1, 2, 3. Learn English with me!
   Review the numbers 0–10; stress “six”.
   [T.SS / S.SS]
▪ Presentation (8-10m): Activity 1 (Listen and repeat):
   T. presents the pictures: “six – sisters – Six sisters.” PP repeat several times (chorally, then individually), isolating the sound /ɪ/ in each word.
   [T.SS / SS.T]
▪ Practice (15-20m): Activity 2 (Listen and tick the box in your copybook when you hear the ‘i’ words):
   T. says the eight words one by one; PP tick the box if the word contains /ɪ/. Example: 1 = ticked.
   Check the picture words and the audio script before the lesson.
   Activity 3 (Listen, look and repeat):
   PP repeat the new words and tongue-twister-like sentences.
   [T.S / S / SS.T]
▪ Use/produce (8-10m): Game: T. says words; PP raise their hand when they hear /ɪ/. Then a pupil says a word with /ɪ/ for the others.
   [S.SS]

lessons.topic: Written — Read, sound and write the small and capital letters i, j, l, t, u in script
objectives: By the end of the lesson, my learners will be able to read, sound and write the small and capital letters i, j, l, t, u in script.
Lexis: letters: i – j – l – t – u (small and capital); family (song).
lessons.body:
Domain: Written
Objective: By the end of the lesson, my learners will be able to read, sound and write the small and capital letters i, j, l, t, u in script.

Lexis: letters: i – j – l – t – u (small and capital); family (song).
Materials: Textbook (p. 17), copybook, lined board, audio (song “Family”).

▪ Warming up (2-5m): The teacher greets learners and welcomes them. 1, 2, 3. Learn English with me!
   Review the alphabet song; recall the letters seen so far.
   [T.SS / S.SS]
▪ Presentation (8-10m): Activity 1: T. reads and sounds the letters i – j – l – t – u; PP repeat.
   Activity 2: T. writes each letter on the board (stroke order); PP write it in the air with their finger.
   [T.SS / S.SS]
▪ Practice (15-20m): Activity 3: PP copy the small letters (i, j, l, t, u) in their copybook.
   Activity 4: PP copy the capital letters (I, J, L, T, U).
   T. circulates and corrects the stroke order, size and position on the lines.
   [S / T.S]
▪ Use/produce (8-10m): Song: “Family” (listen, look and sing).
   Pupils will see the letter forms in script only; avoid cursive.
   [SS]
